entities.title: Heuristic outlines without a grammar, or for large files
entities.summary: Only Rust, Python, C, C#, JavaScript, TypeScript and TSX files up to 1 MiB are outlined from syntax trees; Markdown, TOML and JSON by headings, tables and keys; everything else, and larger files, by declaration keywords and indentation.
entities.impact: Outlines, refs' definitions and read --symbol for other languages, and for large generated files, can miss or misplace symbols.

entities.title: Sessions are not kept
entities.summary: Session ids, the record of what was sent and the requests read-again replays live in daemon memory only, for at most 64 sessions of 512 answers each.
entities.impact: After the daemon exits (it does when idle) or past those limits, a repeated request is answered in full again, and read-again of an older id fails.

entities.title: Files over 256 MiB are not loaded
entities.summary: read, outline and edit refuse a file larger than 256 MiB, and refs leaves it out.
entities.impact: Such a file can be found by ls but not read, outlined or edited.

entities.title: What a walk lists
entities.summary: Directory walks skip .git, honour .gitignore, .ignore and .git/info/exclude (not git's global ignore file) unless -u is given, include hidden files, and leave out symlinks and special files found inside the tree.
entities.impact: Files reached only through a symlinked directory, or ignored files without -u, are not searched or listed.
entities.workaround: Name the symlinked path as a root, or pass -u.

entities.title: Requests up to 1 MiB
entities.summary: The daemon refuses a request frame over 1 MiB; the C invoker's own limit is lower.
entities.impact: A longer command line is refused. Through the invoker, a large --new text can be given on standard input (--new -) instead; an MCP call has no such way round.

entities.title: Stored outputs last an hour, in one process's store
entities.summary: A stored clean, run or proxy output is removed after an hour, or earlier when the store passes its size limit, and is found only by a daemon that uses the same store directory as the process that saved it.
entities.impact: After that, or when `zazzle run` and the daemon see different ZAZZLE_OUTPUTS_DIR or HOME values (a daemon keeps the environment it started with), read-again says the id is not in the output store and the command must be run again.
entities.workaround: Keep ids only for the hour, and give the daemon and the shell the same ZAZZLE_OUTPUTS_DIR (or leave it unset).
